lemma drop_price (hr:rollCaps D ≤ r)(h':gapBelow (fork n f) a D γ): RateLE l T (fun s=>hinge U R z v r c s - hinge U R z v (rollCaps D) c s) (forkBill κ a v m - γ):=by
        refine (RateLE.sum (S:=unkept U R D hr) (f:=growth U R v c (z:=z) r) hT ?_).congr (Eventually.of_forall fun s=>(estimate_suffix U R v c hr s).symm)
        exact fun j hj=> (one_term U R hg v h hT c j).mono (sub_le_sub_left (fare_omitted U R hg v D r j hr h' hj) _)

proof_context.conclusion: Each omitted term is bounded by `one_term` with the gain `fare_omitted` from `gapBelow`, so the unkept sum gains `γ`.

lemma fare_omitted (D:(fork n f).Inner→ℕ)(r:Fin n→ℕ)(q:Branches U R (f:=f) r)(hD:rollCaps D ≤ r){g:ℝ}(h':gapBelow (fork n f) a D g)
     (hq:q ∈ Finset.univ \ Finset.univ.image (advance U R (f:=f) hD)): g ≤ ∑ i, rebate U R v a q i :=by
    obtain ⟨p,hp,h_d⟩:= advance_missed U R v hD hq
    exact le_trans (b:=rebate U R v a q p) (inflate.drop_cost U R (q p) (hg.inside p) (h' p) hp h_d) (Finset.single_le_sum (fun i hi=>terms_nonnegative U R v (fun i=>(hg.inside i).ageLower) q i) (Finset.mem_univ p))

proof_context.conclusion: An omitted term of some child degree above the cap pays the gain `γ` through `gapBelow`.
